evidence.excerpt: They learn surface-form cues rather than the boundary between serving the user and obeying an injected objective, and therefore fail when malicious intent is folded into a plausible workflow and deferred for several turns.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments on three IPI benchmarks, nine baselines, and two base models show that CoDeL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by 88.5% and outperforms other baselines largely (+38.0%).
